# Data owners and stewards

<!-- Generated by governance/build_docs.py from the data dictionary; do not edit. -->


Each Silver table belongs to one domain. The **owner** is accountable for the data and decides what “correct” means; the **steward** works the DQ exceptions and gets them fixed in the source system.

| Domain | Owner | Steward | Tables |
|---|---|---|---|
| Housing management | Head of Housing Management | Housing data steward | silver_property, silver_block, silver_tenancy, silver_tenancy_tenant, silver_tenant, silver_ownership, silver_landlord |
| Finance | Head of Finance | Finance systems analyst | silver_rent_transaction, silver_income_category, silver_suspense_item, silver_purchase_invoice |
| Repairs | Head of Repairs and Maintenance | Repairs coordinator | silver_repair_issue, silver_repair_job, silver_repair_quote, silver_supplier |
| Compliance | Compliance Manager | Compliance administrator | silver_compliance_certificate |
| Lettings and sales | Head of Lettings and Sales | Lettings administrator | silver_applicant, silver_listing, silver_viewing, silver_offer |
| People | HR Manager | HR systems administrator | silver_staff |
| Reference data | Head of Data | Data steward | silver_calendar |

## Rules per owner

| Owner | Rules |
|---|---|
| Head of Housing Management | 23 |
| Head of Finance | 10 |
| Head of Repairs and Maintenance | 6 |
| Compliance Manager | 5 |
| table owner | 4 |
| Head of Lettings and Sales | 4 |
| HR Manager | 1 |

“table owner” rules (keys, links, types, freshness) run on every table and go to that table's owner.

## How a data quality issue is handled

1. `03_dq` runs after each Silver load and writes `dq_results` and `dq_exceptions`.
2. The steward filters `dq_exceptions` to their domain, highest severity first.
3. The record is corrected **in the source system** (Qube, FixFlo or Engage), never in the lakehouse, so the next load brings the fix through.
4. The next DQ run shows the failure count going down; the trend is reported on the Data Quality page of the report.
5. A rule that is wrong (not the data) is changed in `governance/dq_rules.yaml` with the owner's agreement.
